name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
summary: Income support for landholding farmer families, paid directly to the bank account.
benefits: Rs 6,000 per year in three equal instalments of Rs 2,000, transferred directly to the farmer's Aadhaar-linked bank account.
eligibility_text: Landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their name. Excluded: institutional landholders, income-tax payers, holders of constitutional posts, serving or retired government employees (except Group D/MTS), and professionals such as doctors and engineers.
application_process: Register on the PM-KISAN portal (Farmers Corner > New Farmer Registration), at a Common Service Centre (CSC), or through the village patwari / agriculture officer. e-KYC and Aadhaar-bank seeding are mandatory.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (Crop Insurance)

names.te: ప్రధాన మంత్రి ఫసల్ బీమా యోజన (పంట బీమా)
names.kn: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಫಸಲ್ ಬಿಮಾ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಬೆಳೆ ವಿಮೆ)

summary: Crop insurance against yield loss from natural calamities, pests and diseases, at a low farmer premium.
benefits: Farmer premium is capped at 2% of sum insured for Kharif food and oilseed crops, 1.5% for Rabi food and oilseed crops, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops; the government pays the rest.
eligibility_text: All farmers, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers, growing notified crops in notified areas. Enrolment is voluntary.
application_process: Apply before the seasonal cut-off date through your bank, a CSC, an insurance company agent, or the National Crop Insurance Portal. Keep land records and the sowing certificate ready.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
summary: Timely, low-interest short-term credit for cultivation, post-harvest and allied activities.
benefits: Crop loans at a concessional interest rate with interest subvention; prompt repayment earns an additional interest incentive. Also covers animal husbandry and fisheries working capital.
eligibility_text: Owner-cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers and self-help or joint liability groups of farmers.
application_process: Apply at any commercial, regional rural or cooperative bank with land records, identity proof and a passport photograph. Many banks accept the application through the PM-KISAN portal.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
summary: Free soil testing with crop-wise fertilizer recommendations for your field.
benefits: A Soil Health Card listing 12 soil parameters (N, P, K, pH, micronutrients and more) with fertilizer recommendations, free of cost.
application_process: Contact your agriculture department office or nearest soil testing laboratory to have a soil sample collected. Cards can be viewed on the Soil Health Card portal.

name: PMKSY – Per Drop More Crop (Micro Irrigation)

names.hi: प्रधानमंत्री कृषि सिंचाई योजना – पर ड्रॉप मोर क्रॉप
names.ta: பிரதம மந்திரி விவசாய நீர்ப்பாசனத் திட்டம் – ஒவ்வொரு துளிக்கும் அதிக பயிர்
names.te: ప్రధాన మంత్రి కృషి సించాయీ యోజన – ప్రతి చుక్కకు ఎక్కువ పంట
names.kn: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಕೃಷಿ ಸಿಂಚಾಯಿ ಯೋಜನೆ – ಪ್ರತಿ ಹನಿಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬೆಳೆ
names.mr: प्रधानमंत्री कृषी सिंचन योजना – प्रति थेंब अधिक पीक
names.bn: প্রধানমন্ত্রী কৃষি সেচ যোজনা – প্রতি ফোঁটায় বেশি ফসল
names.gu: પ્રધાનમંત્રી કૃષિ સિંચાઈ યોજના – દરેક ટીપે વધુ પાક
names.ml: പ്രധാനമന്ത്രി കൃഷി സിഞ്ചായി യോജന – ഓരോ തുള്ളിക്കും കൂടുതൽ വിള
names.pa: ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਮੰਤਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਸ਼ੀ ਸਿੰਚਾਈ ਯੋਜਨਾ – ਹਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਨਾਲ ਵੱਧ ਫ਼ਸਲ
names.or: ପ୍ରଧାନମନ୍ତ୍ରୀ କୃଷି ସିଞ୍ଚାଇ ଯୋଜନା – ପ୍ରତି ବୁନ୍ଦାରେ ଅଧିକ ଫସଲ

summary: Subsidy for drip and sprinkler irrigation systems to save water and raise yields.
benefits: Financial assistance for installing drip or sprinkler systems; small and marginal farmers receive a higher subsidy share than other farmers. Exact rates vary by state.
eligibility_text: Farmers with cultivable land and a water source. Higher assistance for small and marginal farmers.
application_process: Apply through your state horticulture or agriculture department's micro-irrigation portal or district office.

name: PM-KUSUM (Solar Pumps for Farmers)
summary: Subsidy for standalone solar irrigation pumps and solarisation of grid-connected pumps.
benefits: Central and state assistance covering a large share of the cost of a solar pump; the farmer pays the remainder (bank loans available). Exact shares vary by state.
eligibility_text: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, FPOs and water user associations. Component-wise conditions are set by each state.
application_process: Apply through your state's renewable energy or agriculture department PM-KUSUM portal when applications are open.

name: PM Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana (Farmer Pension)

names.ta: பிரதம மந்திரி கிசான் மான்-தன் திட்டம் (விவசாயிகள் ஓய்வூதியம்)
names.te: ప్రధాన మంత్రి కిసాన్ మాన్-ధన్ యోజన (రైతు పింఛను)
names.kn: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಕಿಸಾನ್ ಮಾನ್-ಧನ್ ಯೋಜನೆ (ರೈತರ ಪಿಂಚಣಿ)
names.pa: ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਮੰਤਰੀ ਕਿਸਾਨ ਮਾਨ-ਧਨ ਯੋਜਨਾ (ਕਿਸਾਨ ਪੈਨਸ਼ਨ)

summary: Voluntary pension scheme for small and marginal farmers.
benefits: Assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month after age 60. The government matches the farmer's monthly contribution (Rs 55 to Rs 200 depending on entry age).
eligibility_text: Small and marginal farmers aged 18 to 40 years with cultivable land up to 2 hectares (about 4.94 acres).
application_process: Enrol at a Common Service Centre with Aadhaar and a savings bank account, or self-enrol on the Maandhan portal.

name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
summary: Online trading platform linking mandis, so farmers can get competitive bids for their produce.
benefits: Transparent online bidding across markets, quality assaying and direct payment to the bank account.
eligibility_text: All farmers selling in e-NAM integrated mandis.
application_process: Register on the e-NAM portal or app, or at your e-NAM mandi, with identity proof and bank details.
